item.name: Special Banner
item.featuredSlotRule: The middle featured unit has a 50% chance at its featured rarity, while the left and right units each have 20%.
item.rarityRates: Rare 75.496%; Epic 20%; Legendary 4%; Mythic or Exclusive 0.5%; Secret 0.004%; Vanguard 0.005%.
item.pity: Legendary pity is 50 summons and Mythic pity is 400 summons. Selection Banner pulls share this pity counter.
item.levelRequirement: Level 10 unlocks Secret, Vanguard, and Shiny summon results.
item.obtainment: Use the Summon area in the lobby and open the Index to inspect the active unit rates.
item.cardSummary: The standard unit banner is the main Gem-based route for building a unit roster. Its featured units change every hour.

item.name: Selection Banner
item.rotation: The selected middle unit stays for 24 hours. Side units rotate hourly when no unit is selected.
item.featuredSlotRule: Choose an eligible Mythic unit for the middle slot instead of waiting for it to appear in the hourly standard rotation.
item.rarityRates: Uses the Special Banner summon pool and featured-rarity rules.
item.pity: Shares Special Banner pity: Legendary at 50 summons and Mythic at 400 summons.
item.levelRequirement: Level 10 unlocks Secret, Vanguard, and Shiny summon results.
item.obtainment: Select an eligible summonable Mythic in the Selection Banner, then spend Gems on summons.
item.cardSummary: The Selection Banner lets players set the middle Mythic for a day, which makes it useful when the standard hourly lineup is not the one they want.

item.name: Event Banner
item.rotation: Featured units rotate hourly while the event is active, and the roster changes with the event.
item.featuredSlotRule: Uses the Special Banner-style featured layout and can include an event-specific Vanguard slot.
item.rarityRates: The active event's Index is the source of truth for its rarity and featured rates.
item.pity: The sources list Legendary pity at 50 and Mythic pity at 400, with a one-time event-gated Vanguard pity.
item.levelRequirement: Level 10 is required for Secret and Vanguard results and for the event Vanguard pity rule.
item.availability: Available only while its event banner is active
item.obtainment: Spend the active event currency in the Summon area. VIP discounts do not apply.
item.cardSummary: Event banners use a separate currency and temporary contents. The banner type recurs, but each event's featured roster belongs in event coverage rather than this evergreen row.

item.name: Special Memoria Banner
item.featuredSlotRule: The middle featured Memoria has a 50% chance at its featured rarity, while the side Memorias each have 20%.
item.rarityRates: Rare 75.496%; Epic 20%; Legendary 4%; Mythic 0.5%; Vanguard Memoria 0.075%.
item.pity: Legendary pity is 50 summons and Mythic pity is 400 summons. Vanguard Memoria pity is a separate rule that should be checked in the active banner.
item.levelRequirement: Level 10 is required for Vanguard Memoria results according to the banner guide.
item.obtainment: Use the Special Memoria Banner in the Summon area and inspect its Index for the active Memoria pool.
item.cardSummary: This is the dedicated pull route for Memorias. Keep it separate from unit banners because the reward pool and progression use are different.
